admission.note: The records are retained for comparison and modelling. They are not verified descriptions of live UK government services.

authorAttribution.name: Paul Buchanan-Jones
authorAttribution.source: Private correspondence supplied to the maintainers; contact details and message text are retained offline and excluded from publication.

capture.determinism: Array order, object key order and values preserve the public Turbopack module exports at capture time.

consistencyFindings.subject: relationship integrity
consistencyFindings.value: 151 references from services/patterns point to 97 pattern identifiers not present in the 19-pattern export; policy records reference 7 absent service identifiers (9 references); 3 graph relationships target absent service identifiers.

extraction.discoveryNote: Chunk names are build-specific. Future runs should rediscover script URLs from the rendered catalogue, graph and person pages, then retain retrieval metadata and hashes.
extraction.method: Fetched the two content-addressed Next.js/Turbopack bundles, evaluated only their static module registration wrappers in an isolated Node.js vm, resolved the data-module imports locally, and serialised every exported record array.

observedImplementation.declaredDemoStorage: The architecture page says service catalogue data is held in SQLite and people profiles are fetched from a localhost Solid Pod server.
observedImplementation.publicDataLocation: Static client bundles and server-rendered Next.js payloads.
observedImplementation.solidPodCheck: The advertised public pod-proxy route returned HTTP 502 for the published Flint Rivers localhost demo WebID on 24 September 2026.
observedImplementation.sourceRepositoryCheck: All five sourceRepository URLs embedded in agent records returned HTTP 404 on 24 September 2026.

provenanceAssessment.notes: Service documentation and endpoint values use demo.gov.example placeholders. The live catalogue therefore cannot satisfy a full-provenance admission requirement for real API records.

evidence.note: Homepage states that the departments, services and people shown are fictional.
About page states that the architecture, records, statistics and impact claims are illustrative and fictional, and that no real government systems or data are connected.
Documentation page states that documentation links in the demo are placeholders.

rights.documentationDecision: Document the exported records as an explicitly fictional synthetic comparison source. Keep record-level rights as not specified and do not imply a reuse licence, government authority or live-service assurance.
rights.finding: No explicit reusable licence or rights statement was located on the public site. The footer's licence link points to a page fragment.

robots.finding: The publication asks all crawlers, including named AI crawlers, not to crawl and publishes no sitemap.
